_README: TEMPLATE for `run_cost.py --outcomes`. Copy it into the run directory, fill it in, and fix `declared_on` BEFORE reading the run's costs. Cost per success is only worth reporting if the definition of success predates the numerator; nothing in the tool can check that, which is why the date is printed beside every figure.
_layer_names: Must match the layer names run_cost.py prints: decision audit, debate roles, desk editors, G1 judges, novelty judge, F1 generators, contrast pass, revision clinic, benchmark, other.

layers._novelty_judge_NOTE: Declare this from artifacts only, before any cost is divided by it. Three counters, reported SEPARATELY and never pooled. A1 occupancy adjudication: a work already in paper_set named as occupying the card's design, with the occupying claim quoted. A2 displacement correction: a displacement_hunch relabelled `verified` or `misread`, quoting the target's own text (`additive` and `unverifiable` stay in the distribution and out of the numerator — `additive` is the modal honest label, so counting it measures nothing). A3 confirmed kill: CONTRIBUTION-NULL with a second independent confirmer, quoting the occupying claim. EXCLUDED from all three: whether the decision audit upheld the verdict, whether a downstream judge agreed, whether a cleared card later won at G1 — each routes a checkable signal through an uncalibrated one. On a retrofit baseline of four cards in a single pass, A1 fired on two, A2 on one, and A3 on none.

novelty judge / A1 occupancy adjudicatio.success_is: a work already in paper_set named as occupying the design, occupying claim quoted

novelty judge / A2 displacement correcti.success_is: hunch relabelled `verified` or `misread`, target's own text quoted

novelty judge / A3 confirmed kill.success_is: CONTRIBUTION-NULL confirmed by a second independent judge, occupying claim quoted

decision audit.success_is: verdict that changed a terminal decision (overturn or reroute)

debate roles.success_is: objection that survived to the defect dossier

comparisons._why: The incremental statistic is the one that decides whether a layer stays. It needs two arms of the SAME work, not two different layers: what the run cost and caught with the layer, against what it would have cost and caught without it.
